# Bundled browser dependencies

These pinned distributions are loaded locally by `index.html` so CSV parsing and bulk PDF/ZIP creation do not depend on a CDN at runtime.

- Papa Parse 5.7.0 — MIT
- html2pdf.js 0.14.0 bundle — MIT (includes its browser dependencies)
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later

The minified files retain their upstream license headers.
